description: This file contains Turkish localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating user should delete characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating user should input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message while more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message when maximum selection is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.
